extraction.Name: Todd Harding Smith
extraction.Refused/Protested: No, I did not know any better, but if it was now and knowing as I do that I should have to pay taxes I would protest.
extraction.Recorded patent: I think I did [sign a receipt for the patent]. I do not remember the date but it was some time ago. I think I got it from the Agency office.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I mortgaged it in order to pay taxes and when the time came to pay the interest I could not pay it so I sold it for what I could get for it.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I borrowed the thousand to pay taxes and when the interest came due on the mortgage I could not pay that, so I had to sell then or run the risk of losing the land for only the thousand.
extraction.Occupation/Income: working at the St. Francis school
extraction.NOTES: Allottee received $1000 at time of mortgage and $1500 additional when sold, totaling $2500; records show consideration of $3500.00 but allottee states he received only $2500; nothing except the mortgage was mentioned as being against the land at time of sale; has 5 children; notary: Jas. W. Cross, commission expires 4-28-32; sworn April 15, 1929; allottee states he did not ask for the patent; satisfied with sale: No — states he was beat out of part of the consideration.
